title: Prioritize Your Mind: Choose Professional Therapy Options

top_liked.text: As much as I like the overall message of this clip, I will say that the fact that you recommended BetterHelp is kinda ironic given that I’ve seen stuff elsewhere indicating that they’re not necessarily the most ethical therapy provider themselves.
